steps.title: Prepare 5× loading dye
steps.instruction: Measure Tris‑HCl (0.2 g/L, 2 mL), SDS (277 mM, 0.8 g), glycerol (4.90 M, 4 mL), β‑mercaptoethanol (570 mM, 0.4 mL), bromophenol blue (1.2 mM, 8 mg) and deionized water to a total of 10 mL in a 100 mL graduated cylinder; vortex vigorously; aliquot 1.5 mL into microcentrifuge tubes; store at –20 °C (stable 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare 6× orange loading dye
steps.instruction: Combine TAE (50×) 2 mL, orange G 0.15 g, glycerol 60 mL, and deionized water 38 mL in a 100 mL graduated cylinder; vortex; aliquot 1.5 mL tubes; store at room temperature (stable 1 yr).

steps.title: Make 1% agarose gel
steps.instruction: In a 200 mL Erlenmeyer, add 1 g agarose to 100 mL 1× TAE (no ethidium bromide); microwave 1 min 30 s; cool to warm; add 1 µL ethidium bromide (0.0001 mg/mL); pour into mold; refrigerate at 4 °C until set.

steps.title: Prepare 10% DOC solution
steps.instruction: Wrap bottle in aluminum foil; add magnetic stir bar, 80 mL deionized water and 10 g sodium deoxycholate; close lid, stir 10–15 min; store at room temperature (stable 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare 70% ethanol solution
steps.instruction: Mix 70 mL 100 % ethanol with 30 mL deionized water in an amber bottle; invert to mix; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Coomassie blue stain
steps.instruction: In a 2 L cylinder, dissolve 1.25 g Coomassie Blue R‑250 and 500 mL 95 % ethanol; add 500 mL deionized water, invert to dissolve; add 125 mL glacial acetic acid; bring volume to 1.250 L with water; invert 5 min; store at room temperature (stable 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare 1 L MES buffer (1×)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 9.76 g MES, 6.06 g Tris base, 1.0 g SDS, 0.3 g EDTA in 500 mL deionized water in a 1 L Duran bottle; stir until clear; bring to 1 L with water; store at room temperature (stable 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare 20 L PBS
steps.instruction: In a 20 L jug fill with ultrapure water; remove 1 L, add 160 g NaCl, 4 g KCl, 23 g Na₂HPO₄, 4 g KH₂PO₄; stir until dissolved; return solution to jug, rock to mix; store at room temperature (stable 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare 1 L SCB buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 10 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl (pH 7.4), 20 mL 5 M NaCl, 1 mL 1 M MgSO₄, and 969 mL deionized water in a 1 L Duran bottle; stir; store at 4 °C (stable 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare 1 L 1× TAE buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 4.844 g Tris‑base, 0.41 g sodium acetate, 0.7445 g EDTA, and 1.93 mL glacial acetic acid in 500 mL deionized water; stir; bring to 1 L with water; store at 4 °C (stable 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare 0.5 M EDTA solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 18.61 g EDTA in 80 mL deionized water; adjust pH to 8.0 with 2 g NaOH pellets; bring to 100 mL with water; stir 5 min; store in acid cabinet at room temperature (stable 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare 5 M NaCl solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 292 g NaCl in 800 mL deionized water in a 1 L Duran bottle; stir until clear; bring to 1 L with water; stir 5 min; store at room temperature (stable 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare DNase solution (10 mg/mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 100 mg DNase I in 10 mL nuclease‑free water; stir until dissolved; aliquot 1.5 mL tubes; store at –20 °C (stable 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare IPTG solution (23.8 mg/mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.476 g IPTG in 20 mL deionized water; stir; filter‑sterilize through a spin column; centrifuge 1 min at 9 021.68 rcf; aliquot 1.5 mL tubes; store at –20 °C (stable 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare Kanamycin solution (100 mg/mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g kanamycin in 10 mL deionized water; stir; centrifuge 1 min at 9 021.68 rcf; aliquot 1.5 mL tubes; store at –20 °C (stable 1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare LB broth (1 L)
steps.instruction: Combine 10 g tryptone, 5 g yeast extract, 5 g NaCl in a 1 L glass vessel; add 500 mL deionized water; stir until dissolved; bring to 1 L with water; autoclave 121 °C 1 h; cool, swirl; store at room temperature (stable 2–3 mo).

steps.title: Transform electrocompetent C41 cells
steps.instruction: Thaw 25 µL OverExpress C41 cells on ice; pre‑chill a MicroPulser cuvette on ice; add cells and 1 µL plasmid (32.3 fmol) to cuvette; flick gently; set MicroPulser to Bacteria EC1; wipe cuvette; electroporate; immediately add 1 mL LB, pipette up/down twice; transfer to tube; incubate 1 h at 37 °C, 200 rpm; plate 25 µL on Kan‑LB agar; incubate 12–16 h at 37 °C; seal with Parafilm, store 4 °C; restreak every 2 weeks.

steps.title: Grow and induce transformed culture
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL 100 mg/mL kanamycin to 100 mL LB broth flask; transfer 5 mL LB to a tube, inoculate with one colony; incubate overnight 12–16 h at 37 °C, 200 rpm; add overnight culture to the same 100 mL LB flask; incubate at 37 °C, 200 rpm, monitoring OD hourly until 0.6–1.0; add 400 µL IPTG; incubate 3 h at 37 °C, 200 rpm; centrifuge 20 min at 3 286 rcf, 4 °C; discard supernatant; freeze cell pellets at –80 °C 12–16 h.

steps.title: Lyse cell pellets
steps.instruction: Thaw pellets on ice; add 10 mL lysozyme buffer (no DTT), vortex until dissolved; add 50 µL 10 % deoxycholate; incubate on ice 30 min; transfer to 50 mL tube; sonicate ~25 % power 10 s ×5; add 100 µL MgCl₂ and 20 µL DNase (10 mg/mL); incubate on ice 1 h; centrifuge 30 min at 3 286 rcf, 4 °C; collect supernatant.

steps.title: Ammonium sulfate precipitation
steps.instruction: Add solid ammonium sulfate to supernatant to reach 70 % saturation (calculate using EnCor calculator, 4 °C, starting volume = supernatant volume); store at 4 °C 12–16 h; centrifuge 10 min at 11 648 rcf; discard supernatant; resuspend pellet in 5 mL 1× SCB buffer; centrifuge 10 min at 11 648 rcf; collect supernatant into a 15 mL tube; test on 1 % agarose TAE gel.

steps.title: Size exclusion chromatography
steps.instruction: Fill column reservoir with 1× SCB buffer; flush column 30 min; stop flow and remove excess buffer; load clarified sample onto column top without disturbing resin; resume buffer flow; start fraction collector and collect drops for ~8 h; stop flow, remove carousel, store at 4 °C; prepare 1 % agarose TAE gel; run every other fraction starting at tube 10; identify VLP‑positive fractions (typically tubes 10–36); pool fractions from one before first positive to one after last positive (e.g., tubes 9–27); add ammonium sulfate to reach 70 % saturation; store at 4 °C 12–16 h.

steps.title: Dialysis for buffer exchange
steps.instruction: Centrifuge pooled sample 10 min at 11 648 rcf; discard supernatant; resuspend pellet in 1 mL 1× PBS; cut 4 in Snakeskin dialysis tubing, soak 15 s in PBS; clip one end, load sample, clip other end; place tubing with magnetic stir bar in tub containing 2.5 L 1× PBS; stir gently (no contact) 24 h; replace PBS with fresh 2.5 L; stir another 24 h; collect dialyzed sample into 1.5 mL tubes; test on 1 % agarose TAE gel and SDS‑PAGE; store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE gel
steps.instruction: Thaw samples and 5× loading dye on ice; in 1.5 mL tubes combine 5× loading dye, 1× PBS/H₂O, then sample (in that order); vortex briefly, centrifuge 30.73 rcf 30 s; heat 95 °C 5 min, cool 5 min; set up Xcell Surelock mini‑cell with fresh 1× MES buffer and a 12‑well NuPAGE 10 % SDS‑PAGE gel; load samples; run at 185 V (400 mA) for 40 min; remove gel, crack mold, transfer gel to container with dH₂O, rinse; stain with low‑toxicity Coomassie solution until covered, microwave 1 min, rock 5 min at 30 rpm; pour stain back, rinse until water clear; add dH₂O, microwave 10 min, repeat destaining until clear; transfer gel to sheet protector for scanning.

steps.title: Run 1 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Weigh 1 g agarose in 250 mL flask; add 100 mL 1× TAE; microwave 1 min 30 s; cool to warm; add 1 µL ethidium bromide; pour into mold, let set at 4 °C; prepare samples by mixing 2 µL 6× orange loading dye with 18 µL sample (total 20 µL); load gel in Mini or Wide‑Sub GT cell filled with 1× TAE to max line; run at 100 V (400 mA) for 20 min; visualize with UV transilluminator (254/302/365 nm).
